facts.text: Columbia International University operates a Prison Initiative that provides incarcerated students with a fully accredited theological education to serve as chaplains and ministry leaders within the prison system.

sources.title: About CIU - Columbia International University
sources.quote: CIU's Prison Initiative equips inmates with a fully accredited theological education, transforming lives and empowering graduates to serve as chaplains and ministry leaders within the prison system.

facts.text: Under the Ram Pell Promise, CIU covers 100% tuition (after subtracting federal and state grants/scholarships, merit scholarships, and athletic awards) for up to four consecutive academic years for eligible South Carolina students.

sources.title: Campus Undergraduate Financial Aid - Columbia International University
sources.quote: Amount: 100% tuition (after subtracting Federal and State Grants/Scholarships, Merit Scholarship, and Athletic Award) per year for up to four consecutive academic years
